Kit summary

Burning PunchBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals 100% ATK DMG and 140% ATK [Internal Injury] DMG to a single enemy, with a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Internal Injury] for 2 turns. At the end of the attack, gains 5 layers of [Martial Art Spirit].
Inferno Gauntlets Lv.1At the beginning of each wave, Aiden gains 20 layers of [Martial Art Spirit]. Increases [Martial Art Spirit] gained from Burning Punch and Burning Combo by 40% and reduces [Martial Art Spirit] consumed by Rage Fist and Meteor Crash by 60%.
Burning ComboActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Deals 3 stages of 100% ATK DMG and 150% ATK [Internal Injury] DMG each to a single enemy, with a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Internal Injury] for 2 turns. At the end of the attack, gains 10 layers of [Martial Art Spirit].
Inferno Gauntlets Lv.1At the beginning of each wave, Aiden gains 20 layers of [Martial Art Spirit]. Increases [Martial Art Spirit] gained from Burning Punch and Burning Combo by 40% and reduces [Martial Art Spirit] consumed by Rage Fist and Meteor Crash by 60%.
Inferno Gauntlets Lv.3Burning Combo and Meteor Crash additionally trigger [Internal Injury] effect for once, up to 6 layers can be triggered. Each time after casting Burning Combo and Meteor Crash, Aiden also gains 1 layer of [Lofty Ambition]: Increases Indomitable Fire's ATK bonus by 20% of the original. Can be owned up to 5 layers and won't be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition.
Warrior EthosPassive
Aiden is immune to [Burn] DMG taken. When [Martial Art Spirit] owned are stacked to 40 layers, cleanses all debuffs from self, enters [Raging Fire] status and gains the following effects: 1. Immune to all control effects. 2. When taking [Burn] DMG, also restores HP by 50% of the [Burn] DMG that should've been taken. 3. There is a 40% chance to counterattack the attacker when being attacked. For every 1 layer of [Internal Injury] owned by the attacker, additionally increases the chance by 10%. Cannot be stacked with [Counterattack]. The chances above are not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES. 4. Exits [Raging Fire] status when all layers of [Martial Art Spirit] are consumed.
Indomitable FirePassiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Increases Aiden's ATK by 20%. When attacking a boss, additionally increases his ATK by 30%. When Aiden takes Fatal DMG, he'll cast Indomitable Crash for once before dying. Indomitable Crash: Deals 80% ATK DMG and 80% ATK [Internal Injury] DMG to all enemies.
Inferno Gauntlets Lv.2Increases Aiden's [Internal Injury] DMG dealt by 12%. Increases Indomitable Crash's DMG dealt by 50%, ignoring [Immortal] and [DMG Immunity]. When an ally takes Fatal DMG, Aiden gains 20 layers of [Martial Art Spirit] if he is not under [Raging Fire] status; otherwise casts Indomitable Crash for once. Aiden can cast Indomitable Crash in this way for once at most after each of his turns and Indomitable Crash cast in this way is considered as counterattacks.
Inferno Gauntlets Lv.3Burning Combo and Meteor Crash additionally trigger [Internal Injury] effect for once, up to 6 layers can be triggered. Each time after casting Burning Combo and Meteor Crash, Aiden also gains 1 layer of [Lofty Ambition]: Increases Indomitable Fire's ATK bonus by 20% of the original. Can be owned up to 5 layers and won't be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition.
